description: HomeFragment.kt is a primary UI fragment for an Android TV app, responsible for rendering the home screen with a top navigation bar, hero banner, 'Continue Watching' rail, and 'TV Channels' rail. It manages focus navigation, layout positioning, data observation via ViewModel, and integration of Compose UI components.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that represents the main home screen of the Android TV app, managing layout, data loading, focus behavior, and user interaction for various UI components.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel. Sets up data sources for the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs and configures the root layout, including the Compose top navigation bar, hero banner, and content rails. Sets focus routing.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Handles focus requests and sets up observers for LiveData state updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Ensures focus returns to the top navigation bar when resuming.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData from the ViewModel and updates UI states for loading, success, and error.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for the continue watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for the continue watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for the TV channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for the TV channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays an error message with a retry option.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the continue watching rail with data and sets focus routing.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV channels rail with data and focus parameters.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds the Compose-based top navigation bar with focus and key event handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Creates and configures the hero banner with horizontal scrolling hero cards.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates and configures the 'Continue Watching' section with a horizontal list.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates and configures the TV channels list section.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus capability on rails based on user interaction.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to actual pixels based on device metrics.
